name: Hou Yi
subtitle: Sunbane Marksman
lore: A half-divine archer, Hou Yi is said to have shot the suns from the sky until only one remained. Whether that tale holds any truth, he has certainly slain countless monsters for the good of Tian. Alas, his many accolades also inflated his ego, making him arrogant, even despotic. The people adore him for his protection, yet fear his growing tyranny.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by enemy. Gain an additional [30] Divinity when [Blaze] inflicts damage to this hero.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Weapon Multiplier +15%, Armor Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Sun and Moon
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy then place [mechanic:intercept] on the ally with the lowest HP for 1 turn. If Chang'e is on the team, she will join the attack.

skills.name: Solar Protection
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 40% chance to place [mechanic:taunt] for 1 turn. If Chang'e is on the team, place [mechanic:protect-ii] on her for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If Chang'e is on the team, place [Protect II] on all allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Nine Suns Shall Fall
skills.description: Remove [mechanic:blaze] from all allies except this hero, then Attack 1 enemy. Has a 75% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] on all enemies except the target for 2 turns. If there are no other enemies alive, place [mechanic:blunt-ii] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Sun Ward
skills.description: When an ally receives [mechanic:blaze], there is a 50% chance this hero receives it instead.
skills.awakening_bonus: This ability is still under review - please check back later.

imprint_passive: When an ally receives [Blaze], there is a 25% chance this hero receives it instead.
